questions.stem: What is the correct order of organs that food passes through in the digestive system?

options.text: Mouth, stomach, oesophagus, small intestine, large intestine
Mouth, oesophagus, small intestine, stomach, large intestine
Mouth, oesophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine
Mouth, oesophagus, stomach, large intestine, small intestine

questions.explanation: Food travels from the mouth through the oesophagus to the stomach, then into the small intestine for further digestion and absorption, and finally to the large intestine.
